turns.match: walk me through 3x + 5 = 20, but make me do each step
turns.script:
scene stack
say title | Solve 3x + 5 = 20
say | Do each step yourself. The next one opens when this one is right.
ask s1 is=15 | Take 5 from both sides, so 3x = __
hint | What is 20 minus 5?
hint | Whatever you do to one side, do to the other: subtract 5.
ask s2 is=5 | Now divide both sides by 3, so x = __
hint | Share the 15 into 3 equal parts.
ask s3 send=no is=20 | Check it: 3 x 5 + 5 = __
hint | Do the multiplying first, then the adding.
